ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: A grid is drawn on the paper, and there is a bold vertical fold line in the center. There are 5 shapes on the left side of the fold line: a right arrow at the top, a half-grid square with diagonal shading at the upper left, a downward arrow in the middle, a circle at the lower left, and a half-grid square with diagonal shading at the bottom. There are also several shapes on the right side of the fold line: a left arrow at the top, a half-grid square with diagonal shading at the upper right, a downward arrow in the middle, a circle, and a half-grid square with diagonal shading at the bottom. Reasoning: Folding the left side to the right along the central thick line is equivalent to reflecting the left-side shapes about this vertical line. Each left-side shape needs to land on the right side in the same row and at the same distance from the fold line, and the mirrored direction and shading must also be exactly consistent. After checking, the right arrow at the top on the left side mirrors into the left arrow at the top on the right side, matching; the upper-left diagonally shaded half-grid square matches the corresponding upper-right half-grid square after mirroring; the middle downward arrow matches the right-side middle downward arrow after mirroring. The position of the lower-left circle is not consistent with the right-side circle's distance to the fold line, so it does not match; the mirror direction/shading of the bottom diagonally shaded half-grid square is not completely consistent with the bottom shape on the right side, so it also does not match. Therefore exactly 3 left-side shapes will completely cover the right-side shapes.

raw_record.question_text: Some shapes are drawn on a piece of paper. The teacher folds the left-hand side of the paper over the central bold line. How many of the shapes on the left-hand side will fit exactly on top of a shape on the right-hand side?

method.method_draft: Use the grid as a coordinate system and reflect each left-side shape across the bold vertical fold line. From the image, note the left-side shapes by row and distance from the fold: a top right-pointing arrow, an upper slanted shaded half-square, a middle downward arrow, a lower-left circle, and a bottom slanted shaded half-square. Read the matching candidates on the right: a top left-pointing arrow, an upper slanted shaded half-square, a middle downward arrow, a circle, and a bottom slanted shaded half-square. The text says the left side is folded over the central bold line, so each left shape must land in the same row and the same number of grid columns to the right of the fold, with its left-right orientation mirrored. Check each left shape: the top arrow mirrors onto the top right arrow, the upper slanted shaded half-square mirrors onto the corresponding upper right half-square, and the middle down arrow mirrors onto the right down arrow. The circle is not at the mirrored distance on the right, and the bottom slanted half-square does not have the exact mirrored orientation/shading. Therefore count 3 exact overlaps.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：纸上画有方格，中央有一条加粗的竖直折线。折线左侧有5个图形：上方一个向右箭头，左上一个带斜线阴影的半格方形，中间一个向下箭头，左下一个圆，底部一个带斜线阴影的半格方形。折线右侧也有若干图形：上方一个向左箭头，右上一个带斜线阴影的半格方形，中间一个向下箭头，一个圆，以及底部一个带斜线阴影的半格方形。
推理：把左侧沿中央粗线折到右侧，相当于把左侧图形关于这条竖直线作镜像反射。每个左侧图形需要落在右侧相同行、与折线距离相同的位置，并且镜像后的方向和阴影也要完全一致。检查后，左侧上方的向右箭头会镜像成右侧上方的向左箭头，匹配；左上斜线阴影半格方形镜像后与右上对应半格方形匹配；中间向下箭头镜像后与右侧中间向下箭头匹配。左下圆的位置与右侧圆到折线的距离不一致，不匹配；底部斜线阴影半格方形的镜像方向/阴影与右侧底部图形不完全一致，也不匹配。因此正好有3个左侧图形会完全盖在右侧图形上。
